title: 後輩が急に英語ペラペラになった理由
hook: 海外の取引先の前で固まる先輩。隣で後輩がすらすら話し出す。
audience: 仕事で英語が必要になって焦っている20〜30代
setting: a Tokyo office meeting room and a commuter train, present day

characters.name: Kenta
characters.look: Japanese man, 30, short black hair, navy suit, slightly anxious face

characters.name: Aoi
characters.look: Japanese woman, 24, shoulder-length black hair, white blouse, calm smile

characters.name: Mr. Miller
characters.look: American man, 45, light brown hair, grey blazer, friendly

shots.camera: close-up on Kenta, client blurred in foreground
shots.frame: Kenta freezes mid-sentence in a meeting, sweat on his forehead, the foreign client waiting
shots.motion: Kenta opens his mouth, hesitates, glances down at his notes; the client tilts his head politely
shots.speaker: senpai

shots.frame: Aoi leans forward with a calm smile and speaks to the client
shots.motion: Aoi speaks fluently with small hand gestures; the client nods and laughs
shots.speaker: kohai
shots.sub: 後輩が、すらすら話し出した

shots.frame: Kenta stares at Aoi in disbelief
shots.motion: slow push-in on Kenta's face as his expression turns from shock to embarrassment
shots.speaker: senpai

shots.frame: after the meeting, Kenta catches up with Aoi in the hallway
shots.motion: Kenta asks earnestly, Aoi stops and turns around
shots.speaker: senpai
shots.line: ねえ、英語どうやって勉強したの？
shots.sub:
ねえ、英語どうやって
勉強したの？

shots.frame: Aoi shows her smartphone with a shy smile
shots.motion: Aoi turns the phone toward the camera and smiles
shots.speaker: kohai
shots.line: 通勤中に、これだけです
shots.sub: 通勤中に、これだけです

shots.camera: medium shot on a morning train, earphones
shots.frame: Kenta on a crowded morning train, earphones in, quietly repeating words
shots.motion: Kenta mouths English phrases under his breath, focused

shots.frame: Kenta confidently shakes hands with the foreign client after a meeting
shots.motion: they shake hands and both laugh; Kenta speaks with confidence
shots.speaker: senpai
shots.line: Thank you. See you next week!
shots.sub: 今度は、自分の言葉で話せた

cta.headline:
通勤10分の英語習慣
まずは無料で

hooks.idea: 見た目の差: 同じ会議室で、英語で笑う後輩と固まる先輩を並べて見せる（物語の時間の外）

shots.camera: medium two-shot, bright office, eye level
shots.frame: Aoi laughs naturally while talking on a video call in English; next to her Kenta stares at his laptop, frozen
shots.motion: Aoi gestures cheerfully; Kenta slowly turns his head toward her with a stunned face
shots.sub:
英語ができる後輩と
できない先輩の差

hooks.idea: 題名で約束: 固まる先輩の顔のアップに題名テロップ

shots.frame: Kenta's face in extreme close-up, eyes wide, a drop of sweat on his temple, meeting room behind him
shots.motion: very slow push-in; Kenta swallows nervously
shots.sub:
英語ゼロの先輩が
3ヶ月後に変わった話
